title: Why Families, Retirees & Remote Workers Love Boone NC
excerpt: From crisp mountain air to a surprisingly connected remote-work lifestyle, the High Country draws people from every stage of life. If you've ever wondered whether Boone, NC might be the right move for you, here's what makes this place so hard to leave.
